name: design-first
description: Design before code: six different first screens built around measured stock photos, type and texture. You pick one, it becomes a live page for desktop and phone, checked for readability before you see it.

pixabay_api_key.title: Pixabay API key
pixabay_api_key.description: Free key for photo search. Open pixabay.com/api/docs, sign up, and copy the key shown in the "key" row of the Parameters table. Leave empty to work without stock photos.
